Recent enforcement of the clean energy rules that require all large scale domestic housing units install renewable energy for water and house heating may have a significant cost effect on future projects by Home Afrika. The government policy to deliver decent housing to working Kenyans is in line with HAL’s business strategy. The supply of equitable housing will in turn increase new consumers/a new market in moderate - income households. data.item: Home Afrika Integrated Annual Report 2020 Effect of Corona Virus i. No processing of survey work at district survey offices and county at large. ii. Reduced mobility. iii. No purchase of maps for confirmation of ground measurement and acreage since land registries are closed. Mitigation Measures i. Processing of Survey work at various government offices being the last step in the entire process, the department made use of the Licensed surveyors and Registered physical planners who were currently working to get the initial approvals for various projects as required by the law. ii. Normal site visits, implementation and maintenance of projects continued to be done for projects within the Nairobi metropolis. iii. The department continued making regular follow-ups with the various contractors to ensure they deliver on their key mandates. These will be accomplished through regular phone calls, zoom meetings, setting of strict timelines for work completion and regular requests for work status reports. 52
